import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EtaleFieldCover

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
universe u

namespace Probe
variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

/-- C. THE GENERAL FORM: picEt is a sheaf for EVERY covering sieve of the etale
topology.  No field extension, no cover, no separability, no finiteness anywhere.
If this elaborates, §4's "payoff" is this at one particular sieve. -/
theorem isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (S : Sieve T)
    (hS : S ∈ etaleTopologyOver k T) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C) (S : Presieve T) :=
  picEt_isSheaf_etaleTopologyOver C _ hS

/-- ... and the file's headline §4 theorem is literally that, applied. -/
example (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C)
      (((Sieve.overEquiv T).symm
        (Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton
          (pullback.fst T.hom
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))))) : Presieve T) :=
  isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve C T _ (sieve_pullback_mem_etaleTopologyOver k' T)

/-- D. The separatedness/ext form, also for ANY covering sieve. -/
theorem picEt_ext_anySieve (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (S : Sieve T)
    (hS : S ∈ etaleTopologyOver k T)
    {t₁ t₂ : (PicScheme.picEt C).obj (Opposite.op T)}
    (h : ∀ ⦃W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ T⦄, (S : Presieve T) g →
      (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₁ = (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂ :=
  (isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve C T S hS).isSeparatedFor.ext h

/-- C'. STRONGER: the SAME §4 statement with a TRIVIAL cover -- identity on T.
Nothing etale, no field extension.  Shows the "descent test" fires on the
identity sieve too, i.e. carries no field-extension content. -/
theorem isSheafFor_picEt_top (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C) ((⊤ : Sieve T) : Presieve T) :=
  picEt_isSheaf_etaleTopologyOver C _ (GrothendieckTopology.top_mem _ _)

end Probe

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.EtaleFieldCover

open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
universe u

namespace Probe
variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

/-- C. THE GENERAL FORM: picEt is a sheaf for EVERY covering sieve of the etale
topology.  No field extension, no cover, no separability, no finiteness anywhere.
If this elaborates, §4's "payoff" is this at one particular sieve. -/
theorem isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (S : Sieve T)
    (hS : S ∈ etaleTopologyOver k T) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C) (S : Presieve T) :=
  picEt_isSheaf_etaleTopologyOver C _ hS

/-- ... and the file's headline §4 theorem is literally that, applied. -/
example (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [Module.Finite k k']
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C)
      (((Sieve.overEquiv T).symm
        (Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton
          (pullback.fst T.hom
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))))) : Presieve T) :=
  isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve C T _ (sieve_pullback_mem_etaleTopologyOver k' T)

/-- D. The separatedness/ext form, also for ANY covering sieve. -/
theorem picEt_ext_anySieve (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (S : Sieve T)
    (hS : S ∈ etaleTopologyOver k T)
    {t₁ t₂ : (PicScheme.picEt C).obj (Opposite.op T)}
    (h : ∀ ⦃W : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ T⦄, (S : Presieve T) g →
      (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₁ = (PicScheme.picEt C).map g.op t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂ :=
  (isSheafFor_picEt_anySieve C T S hS).isSeparatedFor.ext h

/-- C'. STRONGER: the SAME §4 statement with a TRIVIAL cover -- identity on T.
Nothing etale, no field extension.  Shows the "descent test" fires on the
identity sieve too, i.e. carries no field-extension content. -/
theorem isSheafFor_picEt_top (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor (PicScheme.picEt C) ((⊤ : Sieve T) : Presieve T) :=
  picEt_isSheaf_etaleTopologyOver C _ (GrothendieckTopology.top_mem _ _)

end Probe
